label: Locally finite indexed operation times
definition: For a type of operation occurrences and a real-valued timestamp for each occurrence, the family of singleton timestamp sets is locally finite in Mathlib's topology: every real instant has some neighborhood intersecting only finitely many occurrence indices, counting simultaneous occurrences separately. This is a structural condition on a chosen event population, not an assertion that physical events satisfy it.
note: Applies the existing Mathlib.Topology.LocallyFinite predicate to indexed singleton time sets; it does not define a new topology, a universal physical event theory, or a claim of empirical bounded rate. Explicit event identity prevents replacing occurrence count by timestamp-range cardinality. The Zeno sequence violates the condition at its limit endpoint even though it satisfies it before that endpoint.
